Error: interactive connect requires an attached terminal; supply --integration-id, --project, and --token-stdin for automation
Usage:
  hero connect [type] [flags]
  hero connect [command]

Available Commands:
  disconnect  Disconnect from the team server
  team        Connect to a Hero team server

Flags:
      --base-url string         provider base URL
      --global                  save token to global credentials (~/.config/hero/credentials.json) instead of hero.local.json
  -h, --help                    help for connect
      --integration-id string   stable integration ID
      --json                    emit machine-readable redacted status
      --list                    list saved connections
      --local-only              write the complete integration and selectors only to hero.local.json
      --no-verify               save without a provider network verification
      --project string          project identifier (used with --remove)
      --remove string           remove connection for the given tracker type
      --role string             selection role (delivery, docs, roadmap, code-host) (default "delivery")
      --token-stdin             read token from protected standard input (never argv)
      --user-email string       user email (Jira/Confluence Cloud only)

Global Flags:
      --smoke   run smoke verification for this command and exit

Use "hero connect [command] --help" for more information about a command.

interactive connect requires an attached terminal; supply --integration-id, --project, and --token-stdin for automation
